THE VERDICT — QC Evaluator design system

Start at P4 · Report. It is built on real coaching-01 data: the D10 booking
contradiction at L188/L193 is the case the exercise exists to catch, and the
report shows it as INDETERMINATE rather than guessing a score.

Two deliberate departures from the reference build: evidence quotes carry
their line number in the gutter, and the score uses a band rail instead of a
semicircular gauge.

Scores are a defensible read of the transcript, not pipeline output — they
will be replaced by real runs once the scorer is built.

The app runs ink; the PDF runs paper.

BeaverMind's own token set is dual-mode, and a full-black PDF drinks ink and
fails on paper. Same system, correct surface for each medium.
